compat.unavailable: This operator does not offer this yet. It needs operator {version} or later.

connect.heading: Your airdress, administered
connect.lead: Sign in with your Airdress account and choose the airdress to work on.
connect.invalid: Enter a host name, without https:// or a path.

refused.unreachable: That address did not answer. Check it, and that the operator is running.
refused.not_admitted: This operator answered, but does not admit the console. It needs operator v0.1.164 or later, with https://console.airdress.co in its cors_allowed_origins.
refused.no_metadata: This operator does not accept the console yet. It needs operator v0.1.164 or later, connected to Airdress sign-in.
refused.foreign_issuer: This operator trusts a different sign-in service, so the console will not send it your Airdress sign-in.
refused.wrong_resource: This operator describes itself under a different address. Connect using the address it names.
refused.no_console_scope: This operator does not accept console sign-ins.

connect.byAddressLead: For an operator you run yourself, enter its address. You still sign in with your Airdress account.

stepUp.resumed: You signed in again. Confirm to finish what you started.
stepUp.resumedForm: You signed in again. Fill in the form once more to finish what you started.

errors.stepUp: This change needs a recent sign-in. Taking you to sign in…
errors.unavailable: This operator does not offer that.
errors.signedOut: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.unexpected: The operator answered in a way the console does not understand: {detail}
errors.network: The operator did not answer. Check your connection and try again.

codes.not_owner: Only the owner of this airdress can do that.
codes.not_enabled: This is switched off on this airdress.
codes.insufficient_scope: This sign-in cannot do that. Sign out and sign in again.
codes.confirmation_mismatch: That does not match what the machine shows. Nothing was approved.
codes.no_pending_enrollment: That machine is no longer waiting. It may have been approved, denied or have expired.
codes.enrollment_expired: That request expired. The machine has to start again.
codes.source_signing_kind_required: This machine signs function code. Say whether its key was rotated or compromised.
codes.source_base_stale: Someone else changed what runs since you looked. Reload and try again.
codes.principal_not_grantable: The owner cannot be given a grant: the owner can already do everything.
codes.principal_revoked: That person or machine has been removed.
codes.not_delegated: This airdress's DNS is not delegated to its operator, so it cannot hold subnames yet.
codes.duplicate: A subname with that name and type already exists.
codes.cname_conflict: A CNAME cannot share its name with another record.
codes.configured_name: That name is set by the operator's configuration.
codes.invalid_subname: That record is not valid. Check the name, type, value and TTL.
codes.invalid_grant: That grant is not valid. Check the kind, resource and actions.

overview.name: Name
overview.switchesHint: Set by your plan at the hub. The operator only reports them.

people.lead: People who share this airdress. Each has their own conversations and keys.
people.created: {name} was added. Their phone joins with a pairing code from the Airdress app or the CLI.
people.none: Nobody else shares this airdress yet.
people.name: Name
people.pairingHint: The console cannot create pairing codes: the operator only issues them to the app and the CLI.

confirmBody.revoke: Their devices are signed out at their next request, and they can no longer use this airdress.
confirmBody.block: Their name and photo stop being published. Lifting the block later does not publish them again.
confirmBody.unblock: They can choose to publish their name and photo again.

devices.lead: Every device that can use this airdress. Remove one you lost or no longer use.
devices.confirmBody: It is signed out at its next request. To use it again, pair it again.

machines.approveWarning: Only approve a machine you started yourself. Someone who sends you a link can start one too.
machines.proofHint: Type the fingerprint (SHA256:…) or the confirmation code the machine printed. It is not shown here on purpose.
machines.sourceSigningHint: This machine signs function code. Choose what happened to its key: versions it signed keep running after a rotation, and stop after a compromise.

confirmBody.deny: The machine is told no and has to start again.
confirmBody.revoke-key: Machines can no longer use this key to join.

subnames.notDelegated: This airdress's DNS is not delegated to its operator yet, so subnames cannot be added.
subnames.label: Name
subnames.name: Name
subnames.confirmBody: The name stops resolving once caches expire.

shells.off: Shells are switched off on this airdress.
shells.confirmBody: Its channel closes now, and no device can open a terminal on it again until it is approved anew.

grants.lead: What people and machines may do on this airdress, beyond their own things.
grants.resourceHint: Leave empty for every resource of this kind.

functions.lead: Functions running on this airdress. Write and publish them from your editor or the CLI.
functions.name: Function
functions.alsoPause: Also pause the schedules that fire it: {names}
functions.alsoResume: Also resume the schedules paused here: {names}

confirmBody.promote: It replaces the running version. If someone else deployed since you loaded this page, nothing changes and you are told who.
confirmBody.disable: Its route stops answering at the next reconcile. Calls already running finish.
confirmBody.enable: It starts answering again at the next reconcile.

functions.notServed: This operator does not run functions: it was built without them.

choose.heading: Choose an airdress
choose.lead: The airdresses you own. Choosing one keeps you signed in.
choose.none: You do not own an airdress yet.
choose.byAddress: Connect to another operator by address
